  • Help define and deliver the next generation of health insurance technology by building robust platforms and applying AI/ML to enhance processes and decision-making

  • Promote innovation by iterating, and shipping quickly-- treating each release as an opportunity to learn

  • Build and evolve tools for carriers, agents, and consumers-- including enrollment, CRM, and tracking systems

  • Create meaningful roadmap items and platform commitments that promote new business opportunities

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and design teammates in a high-trust, high-accountability environment

  • Improve code quality, scalability, and agility across the codebase

  • Operate in a DevOps culture where teams deliver value multiple times per day

  • Proactively address security, observability, and telemetry in everything you build

  • Learn fast, solve hard problems, and navigate evolving priorities

  • Experience with the full software development lifecycle, supporting features post-launch in agile/lean environments

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails (or similar backend frameworks) and ReactJS (or similar frontend frameworks)

  • Experience with SQL and designing relational data models and reusable components

  • Experience building distributed systems at scale, with an understanding of infrastructure as code
